pow_image — 2D gray op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "pow_image", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: pow_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)
